inputs: m_e (theta = a), alpha, Z (point nucleus); proton mass only in the reduced-mass factor (Z = 1)
rule: zig-zag radial rule (lab/zz_core.py RadialWalk) on graded meshes (lab/nucleo1s_core.py GradedWalk): rotation of each cell with dt = its width, links at c; equal cells = RadialWalk exactly

predictions_law.statement: relative 1s binding error e(a) = K a^(2 gamma) + B a^2 + higher; K from the scale-free inner problem (beta), B from the symmetric BCH second-order Hamiltonian (analytic continuation)

L1.what: uniform meshes a = 0.5/2^k, k = 0..11, Z in {20, 40, 80, 92} (not seen) and 60 (seen): R = (e(a) - K a^2g)/(B a^2) at the finest a (0.5/2^11)

L2.what: measured order of the contact term: p from (e - B a^2) between a = 0.5/2^10 and 0.5/2^11

L3.what: p and d states (kappa = -2, -3) at the same Z: local order between the two finest a

D1.what: doubling: the one-tick walk at Z = 60, a = 0.5 has an eigenvalue at w_1s + pi/a whose state is the staggered copy (-1)^i of the 1s with the OTHER boundary at r = 0 (refl +1); check: w(refl -1 alias) - pi/a == w_1s(refl +1) and the 1s itself is not moved

Z1.what: automatic zoom from the Laboratorio Atomo lattice (equal cells a = 0.5, Z = 60, rmax as orbitali.rs), observable = 1s, budget (estimated error) 0.5 %

Z2.what: cost: zoom cells vs the equal-cell lattice that reaches the same 1s error (found by bisection on a), for budgets 0.5 %, 0.1 %, 0.02 %
Z2.threshold: zoom cells <= 1/3 of the uniform cells, for each budget

Z3.what: 2p3/2, 3d5/2, 4f7/2 on the zoomed mesh (budget 0.5 %), extended to their own rmax with cells 0.5: they must not get worse than on the equal-cell a = 0.5 lattice

Z4.what: honesty of the controller: estimated / true error of the 1s at the stop

N1.what: agglomerated nucleus: the zoom cells inside R = 0.5 (budget 0.1 % mesh) replaced by a 2-number reflection exp(i(d0 + tau w)) learned from the fine rule on w in [0.85, 1.0], separately for kappa = -1 and kappa = -2, -3, -4; levels 1s..4s, 2p3/2, 3d5/2, 4f7/2
N1.threshold: each level within 0.05 % (relative) of the same mesh with the cells

H1z.what: Z = 1, s levels 1s, 2s, 3s with the zoom near the nucleus (outer cells theta = 0.05, 0.025, 0.0125; zoom 14 levels x 16 cells), extrapolated with a polynomial in theta^2 through the three; vs Dirac (infinite mass). Same threshold as the failed H1 of ZIGZAG

H2z.what: Z = 1, 1S-2S frequency (reduced mass) from H1z vs the Dirac formula with reduced mass
H2z.threshold: |lattice error| <= 1 GHz (the QED Lamb shift ~8 GHz must then show up vs experiment)

HY1.what: Z = 1 hybrid: zig-zag zoom for r < (J0 + 1/2) h, learned agglomerated rule (B = 256, cell a0/16) outside, J0 = 3, point-sampled coarse Coulomb; 1s x reduced mass vs Dirac x reduced mass (13.598468 eV). SEEN in development (-0.024 % without reduced mass): weak exam

HY2.what: same with the a0/8 level (B = 512): 2s vs Dirac (re-judges A2b, +1.003 % with the 3-D coarse rule). SEEN in development (-0.096 %): weak exam

HY3.what: NOT seen: He+ (Z = 2) with the same rule and settings (B = 256, J0 = 3): 1s and 2s vs Dirac at Z = 2 (the cell is now a_Z/8 for 1s)

HYs.what: systematics reported without threshold: J0 = 2, 3, 4; shell vs point potential; coarse rule alone (no zig-zag zone)

frozen_settings.autozoom: start equal cells 0.5, split every cell -> eta (relative level change), eps = eta/(1-2^-p), p = 2 (p = 2 gamma for the cell touching r = 0), estimate = |sum eps|; split cells with eta >= 0.3 max eta; 2:1 balance; max 40 iterations
frozen_settings.listening: Newton on arg mu(w) with shift-invert at mu = 1, start 1.3 x Dirac (s) or 1.05 x Dirac
frozen_settings.hybrid: fine zig-zag outer cell theta = a0/4096, 12 zoom levels x 16 cells; coarse s-wave stencil |n| <= 48 from the direction average (400 Fibonacci directions) of the learned generator; point-sampled Coulomb -alpha/r_j (consistent with point values u_j); J0 = 3; full 1-D kernel (no truncation); energy from the generator (G/tau + V), not from the step

dev_hybrid.units: percent vs Dirac, infinite nuclear mass

free_parameters: 0 physical; algorithm settings above (budget, 0.3, 2:1, J0, zoom levels) chosen by hand
